svg.title: Two takes of "seven": a cheap path exists (cost 234, normalized 3.30)
svg.desc: Heatmap of the accumulated DTW cost between two recordings of the word seven by the same speaker, 41 and 30 frames long, with the cheapest warping path drawn on top. The path bends to absorb the difference in length and reaches the top-right corner at a low cost.
svg.text: Two takes of "seven": a cheap path exists (cost 234, normalized 3.30)
